config.description: the settings of a backup before version 2

new_password.description: at least 8 characters, with a number and a special character

allowlist_only.description: the group reaches only the default-deny allowlist

id.description: ignored: the path names the group

lists.description: source ids of the blacklists the group adds

days.description: S M T W H F A, Sunday to Saturday

subnet.description: a private or loopback /24 written as its first three numbers (192.168.1); the backend's own when absent

confirm.description: the reset deletes every list, setting and log, and cannot be undone

confirm_shared.description: required to enable a provider whose network other people's workloads share

label.description: the list's name; not a catalog provider's

url.description: an http or https URL of a list of networks, on a public address

content.description: a pasted list, one entry per line

include_subdomains.description: a domain and every name under it

no_expiry.description: a token that does not expire; not with expires_in_days

SettingsUpdate.description: Setting names and their new values, all as strings; a secret sent empty keeps its stored value (see ?clear=)

scope.description: global: every client; groups: only the client groups that use it

sha256.description: the sha256 GET /api/waf/policy returned, "" when there was no file

hours.description: 1 to 168; another value is read as 24

bearerAuth.description: An access token from POST /api/auth/login, or an API token (spm_<id>_<secret>)

cookieAuth.description: The dashboard's session; a state-changing request also needs X-Requested-With: spm
cookieAuth.name: spm_session

info.description: The management API of Secure Proxy Manager. x-spm-token-scope on an operation is the scope an API token needs to call it: read, write, or none when no token may. x-spm-surfaces names where the operation can be reached: api, and ui, cli and mcp when the dashboard, the spm command or the MCP server offer it; x-spm-api-only, when present, is why only the API offers it, and x-spm-not-in-ui why the dashboard does not.
